$comment: Baseline for rule 2 of eng-tools/check-credentialed-jobs.mjs: `${{ inputs.* }}` occurrences that
still reach the `run:` body of a job holding AWS credentials, counted per workflow and job.
`pending` is a ratchet, not an allowlist. It records what the tree carried when the rule was armed;
the gate fails when a count grows, when a credentialed job the baseline does not name acquires one,
and when an entry sits above reality. `pnpm run check:credentialed-jobs -- --write-baseline` can
only ever shrink it. Zero is the goal.
What is still here, and why it was not drained at once: every remaining occurrence is an
`environment` or a `source_sha`, and both defend themselves inside the job. A job's own
`environment:` is that same `environment` value, so a crafted one resolves no variables, assumes no
role, and never reaches the step; `source_sha` passes `assert-deploy-ref.mjs` — through `env:` —
before the credentials and before every occurrence below. Neither property is written in the
workflow_call contract, which is why they are baselined rather than accepted.
